decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-c6870d2efa84] names the subject exactly: eleven Helm values API keys (pilot.configNamespace, pilot.configSource, pilot.enableProtocolSniffingForOutbound/Inbound, pilot.useMCP, global.autoscalingV2API, global.configRootNamespace, global.defaultConfigVisibilitySettings, global.useMCP, sidecarInjectorWebhook.objectSelector, sidecarInjectorWebhook.useLegacySelectors). It also states the change (removed) and says the keys already had no effect. The note covers several keys, but every key gets the same change in the same Helm values API, and each key is named, so an engineer can write the subject as this set of values keys (or split it per key) without more evidence. The note does not say whether a key that is still set is silently ignored or rejected. That gap matters for the consequence aspect, but the open aspect here is the subject.
